capabilities: remember the settings popout window's size after drag-resizing
remember the settings popout window's position after drag-moving
configure default window width and height
add custom language files for the settings panel
extras: The marketplace listing carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The plugin is desktop-only, requires Obsidian 1.13.0+, and works by monkey-patching app.setting.open and listening to Electron BrowserWindow resize/move events.
intentEvidence: remembers the size and position of the settings popout window (introduced in Obsidian 1.13.0), and restores them automatically
motivation: The author built it because the 1.13.0 settings popout window opens at a default size and position and manual adjustments are lost after closing, so the plugin was written to persist them.
problem: Since Obsidian 1.13.0 the settings can open in a separate popout window, but that window always reopens at a default size and position, and manual adjustments are lost after closing.
summary: Small utility that saves the settings popout window's size and position and restores them the next time the window opens.
